HEAD AND NECK SURGERY

[Click here Surgical wound classification and antimicrobial prophylaxis](surgical-wound-classification)

-Clean procedures include thyroidectomy, lymph node excisions, tonsillectomy,

or funtional endoscopic sinus procedures.

-Clean-contaminated procedures include all procedures involving an incision

through the oral or pharyngeal mucosa, includes esophagectomy and

cancer surgeries.

# If no antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended, select below:

[Click here No antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended for procedure](orz-gtx-abx-pre-op-url-nurse-generic-order)

# Clean procedures, no prosthesis:  No antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended.

[Click here No antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended for procedure](orz-gtx-abx-pre-op-url-nurse-generic-order)

# Clean, prosthesis inserted:

# Preferred:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

Post-op doses are not indicated.

# Alternative for patients with beta lactam allergy:

[Click here Beta-lactam reaction assessment](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Clindamycin 900mg IV once pre-op](psjizid-clindamy-900mg-iv-once-preop)

Post-op doses are not indicated.

# Clean-contaminated procedures including cancer surgery:

# Preferred:

[Ampicillin-Sulbactam 3gm IV once pre-op](psjizid-ampicillin-sulbactam-3gm-iv-once-preop)

Post-op prophylaxis includes q6h x3doses.

Please place post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis order after admission.

< OR >

[Cefazolin weight based dosing once pre-op + Metronidazole 500mg once IV pre-op](orz-set-abx-cefazo-wt-based-iv-metron-500mg-iv-preop)

Post-op prophylaxis includes BOTH medications q8h x2doses.

Please place post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis orders after admission.

# Alternative for patients with beta lactam allergy:

[Click here Beta-lactam allergy assessment](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Clindamycin 900mg IV once pre-op](psjizid-clindamy-900mg-iv-once-preop)

Post-op prophylaxis includes q8h x2 doses.

Please place post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis order after admission.

# References

Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis

in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013 Vol 70 page 195-283
